news.notes: The Jets did not hold a morning skate following a 3-1 win at the New York Islanders on Friday. … Daws starting against his former team is the only lineup change expected for Winnipeg from Friday. ... Hellebuyck is expected to make his first start against his former team since the Jets traded him to the Devils on Oct. 23. ... Rittich, a goalie, is expected to be scratched; otherwise, New Jersey is expected to dress the same lineup it used in a 5-3 win against the Calgary Flames on Friday. ... Dillon, a defenseman, will serve the second of a four-game suspension for an illegal check to the head of Columbus Blue Jackets defenseman Denton Mateychuk during a 3-2 shootout win on Wednesday.
